subject: Frontera vendor activation — invoice cadence & accelerated disbursement request
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lowe <sara@frontera.com>, AP Team <ap@frontera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Frontera vendor activation — invoice cadence & accelerated disbursement request

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. We want to get Frontera set up in our vendor portal and align on the PO / invoice cadence so Finance can approve the activation before the proof-of-concept work starts. Two asks up front:

1) Can you confirm Frontera's standard net terms (Net 30/45/60) and whether you can accept Net45?
2) Frontera mentioned a short-term cashflow need — would you consider a time-limited accelerated disbursement option (see proposal below)?

Attached is our vendor onboarding packet — please return the completed forms and a W-9 and bank validation when you can. Proposed compromise (to expedite approval):
- Default terms: Net45 on validated invoice receipt (no change to pricing)
- Temporary disbursement pilot: Redwood releases 25% of each invoice within 10 calendar days of receipt (upon PO acceptance & invoice validation) with the remainder paid Net45. Pilot cap: $75k / month per vendor; pilot duration 90 days.

If Frontera can provide the W-9 and bank stub today, I’ll route to Finance (David) and Procurement (Marissa) for approval.

Thanks —
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Program Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
From: Sara Lowe <sara@frontera.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@frontera.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Frontera vendor activation — invoice cadence & accelerated disbursement request

Hi Michael —

Appreciate the summary and the proposed pilot. Our standard is Net60, but we can be flexible. The team prefers Net45 if Redwood will commit to the invoice validation SLA (24–48 hours). We can sign up for the pilot you outlined with a couple of changes:

- We request a 50% release on the first invoice to cover ramp costs and then 25% on subsequent invoices, or alternatively a one-time onboarding advance of 25% if that’s simpler.
- We prefer the pilot cap at $100k / month given our project ramp profile.

Attaching our W-9 and a bank validation screenshot. I’ll loop in AP to confirm the email to send invoices to once we’re in the portal.

Attachments: W9_Frontera.pdf, frontera_bank_stub.png

Best,
Sara
Sara Lowe
Head of Operations
Frontera Analytics
sara@frontera.com | +1 212-555-0167
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lowe <sara@frontera.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Frontera vendor activation — invoice cadence & accelerated disbursement request

Marissa / David —

Forwarding Frontera's reply and attachments. Key items: they can move from Net60 to Net45 if we provide a fast invoice validation window; they asked for a larger pilot cap ($100k) or a 50% first-invoice release.

My suggested compromise to get approval quickly:
- Net45 standard terms for all invoices
- Pilot: 25% release within 10 calendar days for all invoices for 90 days; one-time onboarding advance of 25% on first invoice if Frontera needs immediate ramp coverage (no additional processing fee).
- Pilot cap: $75k / month to start; we can review after 30 days.

Operational asks for Procurement / Finance:
- Confirm approval for the 25% within-10-day release pilot and $75k cap.
- If approved, I will send the DocuSign addendum to Frontera and request they complete bank validation in the vendor portal.

Notes: we should require invoice submission via the portal for automated validation to hit the 24–48 hour SLA.

Thanks —
Michael
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Frontera vendor activation — invoice cadence & accelerated disbursement request

Michael / Marissa —

Finance is comfortable approving a constrained pilot with the following conditions:

1) Pilot parameters: 25% release within 10 calendar days, remainder Net45. Pilot cap: $75,000 / month.
2) Activation gating: vendor must be in the portal, bank account validated via micro-deposit, and invoices auto-ingested (no manual email ingestion).
3) Operational controls: Redwood will attach a processing fee of 0.5% on disbursed amounts to cover short-term liquidity burden. Fee will be credited back if Frontera converts to Net45 standard without pilot in 90 days.
4) Legal: we need a signed addendum — I’ll prepare a DocuSign link.

If Marissa confirms procurement readiness, David approves and I’ll finalize DocuSign.

-David

David Kim
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lowe <sara@frontera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Frontera vendor activation — invoice cadence & accelerated disbursement request

Sara —

Good news: Finance has approved a constrained pilot. Final agreed path below:

- Standard payment terms: Net45 after invoice validation.
- Pilot (90 days): Redwood will issue 25% of each validated invoice within 10 calendar days of invoice receipt; remainder paid Net45.
- Pilot cap: $75k / month.
- Processing fee: 0.5% applied to disbursed portion (credited back if pilot converts to Net45 without extended runway).
- Activation gating: portal onboarding complete + micro-deposit bank validation + invoices submitted via portal.

I’ve attached the onboarding packet and the DocuSign addendum. Please sign the addendum and upload the bank validation to the portal; once complete, Procurement will provision your vendor record and we’ll issue POs for the kickoff SOW.

Links: https://redwood.app/docusign/ADDENDUM-4821 (DocuSign)
Portal onboarding folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/onboarding/Frontera/packet

If you want the onboarding advance instead of a 25% first invoice release, let me know in your signature on the addendum and we’ll route for final approval.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to getting Frontera live.

Best,
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Program Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
